usage: agentware trust [-h] [--format {text,json}] <subcommand> ...

positional arguments:
  <subcommand>
    list                list pinned publisher keys
    pin                 trust a publisher key (onboarding / first clone)
    rotate              trust a NEW key during an overlap window (operator-
                        confirmed rotation)
    verify              check trust-anchor integrity + in-tree fingerprint
                        match

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --format {text,json}  output format (default: text)
